shortDescription: Bilateral hip extension on a 45-degree bench, using both legs together to train the glutes and hamstrings.
descriptionHtml:
A bilateral hip hinge on a 45-degree Roman-chair bench. Both feet stay secured while the torso lowers and rises around the supported hips.

Keep your spine neutral and finish with your torso aligned with your legs. The demonstration uses bodyweight with arms crossed over the chest.
instructions: Adjust the hip pad so it supports your upper thighs just below the hip crease, leaving room to hinge at your hips.
Place both feet on the platform and secure both ankles beneath the padded supports. Keep your knees softly extended.
Cross your arms over your chest, brace your trunk, and start with your head, torso and legs aligned.
Hinge forward at your hips to lower your torso under control. Keep your feet fixed and your back neutral, stopping within your comfortable range.
Contract your glutes and hamstrings to bring your torso back into line with your legs. Stop at alignment rather than arching your lower back.
Repeat without bouncing or swinging. Hold the bench supports when getting on or off.
notes: Both legs remain supported together throughout the movement. Start with bodyweight; log only added external weight when progressing. Muscle factors are app defaults, not measured activation. Generated media is an illustrative pose animation.
